effects.effect: Whenever you use the [Knockback](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.maneuvers/knockback) maneuver, you can then use the [Aid Attack](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.maneuvers/aid-attack) maneuver as a free [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action).
